traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The dhergoloth's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 10). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: darkness, fear * 3/day: sleep

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The dhergoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: The dhergoloth's weapon attacks are magical.
